$comment: The manifest of published documentation versions.
Each entry is a git ref that CI checks out and builds as its own copy of
this site, at its own base path. Nothing about a version is stored twice in
the repository: v0.3's documentation is whatever v0.3's tree says, because
that is literally what gets built.
ref       git ref to check out (tag or branch)
base      URL prefix it is served under, leading and trailing slash
preview   true for a development line; the switcher marks it
`default` names the version ALSO published at the site root, so that
https://novis-lang.org/docs/ is always the current stable documentation.
Today there is one entry, because Novis has no releases yet. Cut a tag, add
a line, and the switcher grows a option. That is the whole procedure.
